items.title: "We view AI as a sliding scale. There will always be a human in the loop; that's our ethos": Why Side has signed an MOU with Modl.ai to use AI for QA
items.excerpt: Side and Modl.ai signed a six-month binding MOU on an AI-enabled QA system that plays a retail build by looking at the screen, generates a data set, and hands bug reports to human QA specialists.
